answer: A $600 honesty market prices every identity. Three strangers stake $200 each on a newcomer staying clean. Passing earns a jade seal. The seal's price delta against older seals outs a clone farm. A seal held twenty epochs turns relic, worth double. Each extra identity per backer adds $15, so 100 clones cost $134,250, one honest agent $600. Five rotating auditors sample 5% of sealed agents per epoch, replaying ten actions. A caught clone burns its seal, its backers lose $200 each and sit out ten epochs. A pawnshop rewards regulars and turns away a stranger with a hundred identical watches.
